result.brief: 提出动作中心的统一具身模型EWAM，通过非对称联合注意力让动作token逐层读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来帧与动作信息，无需逐层监督即涌现出从语义理解到视觉预见再到动作生成的深度分工。
result.reason: Unified embodied model with predicted-future visual foresight and action-conditioned dynamics, plus emergent depth-wise specialization; directly supports embodied world models and planning control.
